facts.statement: Zhuchengceratops is an extinct ceratopsian dinosaur belonging to the family Leptoceratopsidae that lived in modern-day China during the Upper Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Zhuchengceratops is a genus of extinct leptoceratopsid ceratopsian that lived during the Upper Cretaceous of modern-day China.

facts.statement: The genus Zhuchengceratops was first described in 2010 by Xu et al. with the type species Zhuchengceratops inexpectus.
facts.quote: It was first described in 2010, by Xu et al., who created the binomial Zhuchengceratops inexpectus.

facts.statement: Fossils of Zhuchengceratops were recovered from the Wangshi Group, which dates to the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: The fossils were recovered from the Wangshi Group, of the Late Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Zhuchengceratops was named by Xing Xu, Kebai Wang, Xijin Zhao, Corwin Sullivan, and Shuqing Chen in 2010, with Zhuchengceratops inexpectus as the type species.
facts.quote: This genus was named by Xing Xu, Kebai Wang, Xijin Zhao, Corwin Sullivan and Shuqing Chen in 2010, and the type species is Zhuchengceratops inexpectus.

facts.statement: Zhuchengceratops possessed a particularly massive and deep mandible that was 50 centimeters long and thin transversely.
facts.quote: Zhuchengceratops had a particularly massive and deep 50 cm-long mandible that is also thin transversely.

facts.statement: The holotype ZCDM V0015 is an incomplete articulated skeleton including the combined skull, maxilla, squamosal, jugal, quadrate, wings, outer ring, mandible, the first fourteen vertebrae, ribs, and some additional elements.
facts.quote: El holotipo, ZCDM V0015, es un esqueleto incompleto articulado incluyendo el cráneo combinados, hueso maxilar, cuadrado-cigomático, cigomático, cuadrado, alas y anillo exterior, la mandíbula, las primeras catorce vértebras, las costillas y algunos elementos adicionales.

facts.statement: These fossils were discovered in 2008 alongside numerous articulated combined bones of the hadrosaurid Shantungosaurus.
facts.quote: Estos fósiles fueron descubiertos en 2008 junto a numerosos huesos articulados combinados del hadrosáurido Shantungosaurus.

facts.statement: Zhuchengceratops lived during the late Cretaceous period, approximately 75 million years ago in the Campanian stage, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 75 millones de años, en el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis by the authors suggests Zhuchengceratops is an advanced leptoceratopsid more closely related to Leptoceratops and Udanoceratops, although the internal relationships of this triplet remain unresolved.
facts.quote: Según el análisis filogenético llevado a cabo por los autores es un leptoceratópsido avanzado, más relacionado con Leptoceratops y Udanoceratops aunque las relaciones internas de este triplete no se resolvieron.

facts.statement: The time range for Zhuchengceratops is the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)
